# IIIFManifestLoader { #timetoalign.loader.graphical.IIIFManifestLoader }

```python
loader.graphical.IIIFManifestLoader()
```

Load image metadata from IIIF Presentation API manifests.

IIIF manifests contain canvas dimensions that represent image sizes.
This loader extracts width/height for use with graphical timelines
without needing to download or load the actual image files.

Supports both IIIF Presentation API 2.x and 3.x formats.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.testdata import ensure_data
>>> manifest = ensure_data("supra") / "image" / "ifff_manifest.json"
>>> loader = IIIFManifestLoader().load(manifest)
>>> loader.dimensions
{'width': 4096, 'height': 299400}
```

Individual canvases carry their own label and dimensions:

```python
>>> for canvas in loader.manifest_info.canvases:
...     print(f"{canvas.label}: {canvas.width}x{canvas.height}")
display image: 4096x299400
```

### create_timeline { #timetoalign.loader.graphical.IIIFManifestLoader.create_timeline }

```python
loader.graphical.IIIFManifestLoader.create_timeline(
    uid=None,
    name=None,
    axis='height',
)
```

Create a graphical timeline from the loaded IIIF manifest.

The timeline length is determined by the image dimensions along the
specified axis (height by default, for vertical piano rolls).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                 | Description                                                                                                                                | Default    |
|--------|----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| uid    | [str](`str`) \| None | Unique identifier for the timeline. Auto-generated if None.                                                                                | `None`     |
| name   | [str](`str`) \| None | Human-readable name. Uses manifest/canvas label if None.                                                                                   | `None`     |
| axis   | [str](`str`)         | Which dimension to use as the timeline axis: - "height" (default): Timeline length = image height - "width": Timeline length = image width | `'height'` |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                           | Description                                         |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
|        | [DiscreteGraphicalTimeline](`timetoalign.timelines.DiscreteGraphicalTimeline`) | A DiscreteGraphicalTimeline representing the image. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                           | Description                         |
|--------|--------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
|        | [RuntimeError](`RuntimeError`) | If no manifest has been loaded.     |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`)     | If axis is not "height" or "width". |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> loader = IIIFManifestLoader()
>>> loader.load("manifest.json")
>>> timeline = loader.create_timeline(uid="dgt1_image")
```
